in_sanskrit.name: Darji
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ruler of the sky
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Darji एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Darji is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dhavaj’, which means 'sky' or 'heaven'. The name is often given to boys born under auspicious circumstances, signifying their potential to rule and protect like the celestial bodies.
